image_description: A close-up view of a car wheel mounted on a light blue vehicle. The wheel features a highly reflective chrome alloy rim with five thick, curved spokes and a central hub cap. A black rubber tire with visible tread patterns surrounds the rim. The background shows the car's fender and a gravel surface.
